gaps.sentence: If only we ___ the tickets before they sold out!
gaps.explanation: 'If only' plus the past perfect regrets a missed past opportunity: had bought.

gaps.sentence: Unless it ___ below five degrees tonight, the event will go ahead.
gaps.explanation: 'Unless' clauses take the present simple even when referring to tonight: drops.

gaps.sentence: Children may use the pool provided that they ___ by an adult.
gaps.hint: provided that plus a passive rule
gaps.explanation: Rules with 'provided that' use the present simple passive: are accompanied.

gaps.sentence: He always carries a power bank in case his phone ___.
gaps.hint: in case plus the present simple
gaps.explanation: 'In case' takes the present simple for things that might happen: dies.

gaps.sentence: You can borrow the car ___ you return it by Sunday.
gaps.explanation: 'Provided you return it' sets a condition.

gaps.sentence: If only I ___ more at university!
gaps.explanation: 'If only + past perfect' — regret about a past failure.

gaps.sentence: We will refund the item provided that you ___ the receipt.
gaps.hint: provided that plus a present requirement
gaps.explanation: 'Provided that' states a requirement using the present simple: have.

gaps.sentence: If I ___ a million euros, I would travel the world for a year.
gaps.explanation: Second conditionals use the past simple after 'if' for unreal presents: won.
